cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.
